Assam Chief Minister's Fellow Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The Government of Assam has announced 256 Chief Minister's Fellow positions to support entrepreneurship development and implementation of the CMAAA programme across the state.

content_sections.heading: Assam Chief Minister's Fellow Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must hold an MBA, MBA-equivalent qualification or Master's degree in Social Sciences, Public Policy or Development Studies from a reputed university or institution, with a meritorious academic record and at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA in the qualifying postgraduate qualification. Important Marks Clarification: The 60% minimum applies only to the qualifying postgraduate degree or MBA-equivalent qualification. Candidates are not separately required to have 60% marks in Class 10, Class 12 or graduation. Where CGPA is awarded, candidates must calculate the equivalent percentage according to the conversion formula prescribed by their university or institution. The notification gives preference to candidates from premier institutions such as: Indian Institutes of Management (IIMs). Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs). Institute of Rural Management Anand (IRMA). Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS). National Institute of Rural Development (NIRD). Professionals working in multinational companies or international organisations who wish to take a sabbatical and contribute to the social sector are also welcome to apply, provided they meet the prescribed eligibility requirements. Applicants should be prepared to work closely with government departments, entrepreneurship beneficiaries and other programme stakeholders across Assam.

content_sections.heading: Assam Chief Minister's Fellow Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Fellows will receive annual remuneration of Rs. 6 lakh in the first year and Rs. 6.60 lakh in the second year . These amounts include the specified travel expense component. Remuneration Clarification: The monthly equivalents are calculated from the advertised annual packages and include travel expenses. They should not be described as guaranteed monthly take-home salary. The notification does not specify a separate payment schedule or deductions. The total advertised remuneration over the full 24-month fellowship is Rs. 12,60,000 , including the travel expense components, subject to continuation under the performance evaluation conditions.

rows.remuneration_details: Monthly Equivalent of Total Annual Package

content_sections.heading: Assam Chief Minister's Fellow Duration 2026
content_sections.text: The fellowship duration is 24 months . Selected candidates are expected to join in December 2026 and undergo orientation, exposure visits and on-the-job training. Performance will be evaluated every six months against mutually agreed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Continuation of the fellowship depends on the outcome of these evaluations.

content_sections.heading: Assam Chief Minister's Fellow Job Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Fellows will help CMAAA beneficiaries develop viable business ideas and support entrepreneurship development across Assam. Mentor beneficiaries in developing their business ideas into viable enterprises. Support project planning, enterprise development and entrepreneurship activities. Work with the Office of the Chief Executive Officer, CMAAA Society. Coordinate with District Industries and Commerce Centres. Collaborate with District Commissioners and other government departments. Help beneficiaries connect with banks and financial institutions. Work with universities, research stations, NABARD and NEDFi. Coordinate with progressive farmers, local entrepreneurs and start-ups. Support programme implementation and stakeholder coordination. Contribute to performance monitoring and achievement of agreed programme objectives. Selected Fellows will be placed across Assam according to programme requirements. Their assignments may involve working with CMAAA Society, District Industries and Commerce Centres, District Commissioners and other relevant departments.

content_sections.heading: Assam Chief Minister's Fellow Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of application shortlisting, group discussion and interview . Online Application: Candidates must submit their applications through the official recruitment portal. Shortlisting: Applications will be reviewed against the required qualifications and eligibility conditions. Group Discussion: Shortlisted applicants will be called for a group discussion. Interview: Candidates will attend an interview as instructed by the selection authority. Final Selection: Selected candidates will be informed of the joining and induction requirements. Orientation: Fellows will undergo the initial orientation programme before beginning their assignments. The notification does not prescribe a separate written examination, group discussion marking scheme or interview weightage. The dates and venue arrangements will be communicated through the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: Assam Chief Minister's Fellow Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit applications for the 256 Chief Minister's Fellow positions through the Assam Government Niyukti recruitment portal. Apply Online: Assam Chief Minister's Fellow Official Application Portal Official CMAAA Website: cmaaa.assam.gov.in Application Start Date: 1 November 2026, 12:00 noon. Application Last Date: 14 November 2026, 11:59 PM. Candidates should use the Chief Minister's Fellow recruitment link, not the separate beneficiary application process for CMAAA financial assistance.

content_sections.text: MBA, MBA-equivalent or prescribed Master's degree certificate. Qualifying postgraduate marksheets. University or institution CGPA-to-percentage conversion formula, where applicable. Other educational certificates requested by the portal. Documents supporting relevant professional experience, if claimed. Identity and personal information documents required by the application form. Recent photograph and signature, in the formats requested by the portal. Other supporting documents specified by the recruiting authority.

content_sections.heading: Assam Chief Minister's Fellow Learning Opportunities and Certificate
content_sections.text: The fellowship provides practical experience in entrepreneurship development, programme management, leadership and government coordination. Fellows will have opportunities to work with government departments, financial institutions, universities, entrepreneurs and start-ups while addressing enterprise development challenges. After successful completion of the fellowship, participants will receive a CMAAA–CM Fellow citation and certificate personally signed by the Chief Minister of Assam .
